title: A 20-Kilometer Neutron Star Outweighs The Sun
hook: A 20-kilometer star can outweigh the Sun.
closing: Neutron stars show how violently gravity can compress ordinary matter.
question: Which shocks you more: size or mass?

segments.say: A neutron star spans about 20 kilometers, squeezing stellar mass into a city-sized sphere.
At 2.2 solar masses, a neutron star crosses the collapse limit toward a black hole.
Astronomers have cataloged 3,400 neutron stars, so these extreme objects are no longer rare discoveries.
